description.html: This 75x35x45 cm terrarium (118.1 L) is made of quality glass and covered on the outside with film of your choice. The film gives the terrarium a neat look that fits your interior, with wood, bamboo and marble patterns or solid black or white available.

A length of 75 cm and a width of 35 cm provide a large floor area for ground-dwelling species. On this floor area you can easily set up a basking spot and a cool side, the basis of proper reptile care. The ventilation system with a protective mesh keeps fresh air flowing and prevents moisture buildup.

When ordering, you choose the decorative film, the 3D background style and the ventilation type. Non-standard dimensions, LED lighting and a thermostat are available as options. Call us or message us on WhatsApp for full details. Delivery across Serbia.
